title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: This committee ensures Indian badminton players have a direct voice in the administration of the sport within the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has officially formed its new Athletes Committee, aiming to give players a stronger voice in the sport's governance.

title: Indian Juniors Train in Guwahati for BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: The national coaching camp in Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: India's promising junior shuttlers are currently undergoing an intensive national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, gearing up for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Concludes Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course enhances the skills of Indian coaches, directly impacting the quality of training for future generations of Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course across two National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, concluding on September 23rd.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern one of India's premier domestic team competitions, which is vital for identifying and developing talent across states.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the official regulations for the highly anticipated Inter State Team Championships 2026, setting the stage for the upcoming domestic competition.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will be implemented across all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, directly impacting the development of young Indian shuttlers.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
